verdict.rationale: Fivetran documents 700+ maintained connectors across SaaS apps, databases, event streams, and files (fivetran-docs-54, fivetran-docs-24, fivetran-docs-18), with per-connector setup guides showing maintained feature parity (data blocking, capture deletes, row filtering) as in the Akamai/ClickUp docs. Community corroboration confirms Fivetran's catalog is best-in-class ('no one has as complete a catalog of integration plugs as Fivetran' - fivetran-comm-18) and reliable for avoiding API maintenance work (fivetran-comm-14), with a Connector SDK for custom sources when a connector doesn't exist. Missing for 10: no independent breakdown of exact connector freshness/maintenance cadence or coverage gaps for niche APIs.
